CustomField.label: Wartungsvertrag status
CustomField.description: SCRUM-451: Remaining time at a glance - "in 45 days", "ends today", "expired". Blank end date = blank (never recorded). System-computed formula field, read-only; no negative day count is ever produced.
CustomField.formula: IF(ISBLANK(Wartungsvertrag_End__c), null, IF(Wartungsvertrag_End__c < TODAY(), "expired", IF(Wartungsvertrag_End__c = TODAY(), "ends today", "in " & TEXT(Wartungsvertrag_End__c - TODAY()) & " days")))
